item.title: Tuesday 10 November
item.description: Clear and cold at ten degrees, a rest day on the cut, and a crash on the M4 eastbound to dodge on the way to RPAH. The Extra Shot pours over Nvidia's Jensen Huang story, Apple's agentic Siri push, and GTA 6: The Festival.
